risks.title: Pressure on insurance policy persistency
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed in detail in the context of high cost-of-living impact on policy lapse rates for term life insurance, with language affirming that lapse rates remain above historical levels. This risk directly impacts recurring revenues and profitability, and persistency is a key indicator of insurance portfolio health. The Industrial category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Decline in independent agent recruitment
risks.score_rationale: The number of new recruits declined by nearly 20% in 2025 compared to 2024, although the level remains within historical norms. The text emphasizes that recruitment is a key indicator of future growth. Sustained decline could impact long-term distribution and sales. Language intensity is moderate but the risk is systemic to the business model.

risks.title: Variance in actuarial assumptions
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions that results will be affected by deviations between actuarial assumptions and actual experience, particularly regarding mortality, persistency, and interest rates. An unlocking of assumptions can directly impact financial results and reserves. Language is technical but potential impact is existential, hence maximum severity.

risks.title: Sensitivity to economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly links product demand to economic conditions (inflation, unemployment, consumer confidence). It mentions that economic uncertainty has impacted consumer behavior. This risk is repeated multiple times and affects both insurance and investment product sales. The Macro category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Exposure to interest rates
risks.score_rationale: The investment portfolio accumulated unrealized losses due to rising rates in 2022-2023, although these decreased in 2025. The company clarifies that it does not realize losses if it has no intention to sell. However, future rate increases or market deterioration could force sales. The risk is well-documented and serious.

risks.title: Canada-U.S. currency exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Results in Canada, converted to U.S. dollars, are affected by exchange rate fluctuations. Canadian dollar strength in 2025 had a positive impact, but future depreciation could harm consolidated results. The risk is real but partially offset by diversification.

risks.title: Dependence on independent agent network
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily depends on the size and productivity of its independent agent network to generate sales. The decline in productivity (0.18 vs 0.21 policies/month/agent) is highlighted as a factor in sales decline. This risk is central to the business model and repeated across multiple sections.

ai_positioning.summary: Primerica does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on the company's financial, investment, and operational aspects without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
